name: Washi tape — zine corner accent
description: Two strips of washi tape pinning a research-paper Surface to the frame, creating the torn-paper zine collage look from the Syntax aesthetic. Yellow tape (rotation +18°) crosses the top-left corner of the paper card; red tape (rotation −14°) anchors the top-right corner. Demonstrates the washi-tape overlay pipeline's rotation, length, and multi-instance placement. Light cream paper substrate; tape settles in slightly after the card.

content.title: The Web Will Outlive Us All
content.author: Scott Tolinski
content.body:
The platforms we depend on will pivot, deprecate, and vanish. The open web keeps running.

Every tool, every framework, every build pipeline is a wager on a moving target. The bet that compounds is the one placed on fundamentals — HTML, CSS, the URL, the document.

Build on bedrock. The tide goes out; bedrock stays.
